items.title: Kalshi Denies Faking Its Crypto Volume
items.summary: The exchange says the repeating trade size that drew wash-trading accusations over the weekend came from one market maker it pays to keep orders on the book, and that the maker was losing money to faster traders.

items.title: Zcash gets first European ETP following US ETF launch
items.summary: 21shares listed physically backed ZEC and ETHFI products on Euronext Paris and Amsterdam, as issuers broaden their offerings beyond major cryptocurrencies.

items.title: Solo GP Jed Breed raises $15 million for his second early-stage crypto fund
items.summary: Breed VC has raised $15 million for its second crypto fund.

items.title: Next for the U.S. SEC: Agency's chief crypto counsel illuminates path for custody
items.summary: Taylor Lindman, the top lawyer on the agency's Crypto Task Force, says the SEC is trying to get firms comfortable with blockchain technology and crypto assets.
